title: Bargain Bin Gems: £4.0m Defenders & £4.5m Midfielders
dek: The enablers actually starting matches. Filtered on minutes played rather than price, because a cheap player who does not play is not a bargain.
body:
## Why enablers decide squads

The cheapest player who actually starts is worth more than a better player who does not. An enabler's job is to be £4.0m and play 90 minutes; everything beyond that is profit.

> Filtered on minutes per gameweek across 1 round, not on price alone. A cheap player with no minutes is not a bargain, he is a hole in your team.
